title: Methods of determing biokinetics of arsenate accumulation and release in Microcystis aeruginosa regulated by common environmental factors: Practical implications for enhanced bioremediation
author: Wang, Luo, et al.

steps.title: Prepare freeze‑dried algae
steps.instruction: Obtain freeze‑dried Microcystis aeruginosa biomass to be analysed for total arsenic.

steps.title: Microwave‑assisted digestion
steps.instruction: Subject the freeze‑dried algae to microwave‑assisted digestion according to the previously reported method.

steps.title: Measure total arsenic by ICP‑MS
steps.instruction: Analyse the digested samples for total arsenic using an Agilent 7500cx ICP‑MS instrument.

steps.title: Check signal stability
steps.instruction: Verify instrument signal stability by simultaneously monitoring the masses of ⁷²Ge and ¹⁰³Rh during the ICP‑MS run.
